name: Mixo

pricing.free_plan: Free forever with a Mixo-branded URL and the Mixo badge; one page, contact form included

tiers.name: Business
tiers.note: custom domain, no badge, multi-page, 20% off annual

capabilities: Writes a whole site from one free-text description in about two minutes
Chooses images and copy itself, then offers style variants
Contact form and gallery are included on the free plan
limits: Free plan is one page plus a gallery; multi-page sites need the Business tier
Custom domain costs 30 $/year or a paid plan
No series pages and no about section unless they are asked for page by page
